%% foreign keys by check_class_diagram.py.

classDiagram
    direction TB

    %% ======== UC-01 ========

    %% People - table `users`
    class User [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        name : varchar(255)
        email : varchar(255)
        password : varchar(255)
        role : varchar(255)
        status : varchar(255)
        failedLoginAttempts : smallint
    ]

    %% Term - table `audit_logs`
    class AuditLog [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        action : varchar(64)
        subjectType : varchar(64)
        properties : json
        createdAt : timestamp
    ]

    %% ======== UC-02 ========

    %% People - table `student_profiles`
    class StudentProfile [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        matricNo : varchar(32)
        programCode : varchar(8)
        yearOfStudy : smallint
        sectionId : bigint <<FK>>
    ]

    %% People - table `supervisor_profiles`
    class SupervisorProfile [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        programCode : varchar(8)
        capacityPsm1 : smallint
        capacityPsm2 : smallint
    ]

    %% Registration - table `supervisor_agreements`
    class SupervisorAgreement [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        supervisorProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        proposedTitle1 : varchar(255)
        agreedTitle : varchar(255)
        status : varchar(255)
        studentSignedAt : timestamp
        supervisorAcknowledgedAt : timestamp
    ]

    %% Registration - table `supervision_assignments`
    class SupervisionAssignment [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        supervisorProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        isActive : boolean
        effectiveFrom : date
        effectiveUntil : date
        endedAt : timestamp
    ]

    %% Registration - table `project_members`
    class ProjectMember [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        isLeader : boolean
    ]

    %% Registration - table `student_enrolments`
    class StudentEnrolment [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        attemptNo : smallint
        status : varchar(32)
        repeatsEnrolmentId : bigint <<FK>>
    ]

    %% Chain - table `lampiran_b_forms`
    class LampiranBForm [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        milestoneId : bigint <<FK>>
        revisionNo : smallint
        title : varchar(255)
        status : varchar(32)
        rejectedReason : text
        supersededById : bigint <<FK>>
    ]

    %% ======== UC-03 ========

    %% Chain - table `projects`
    class Project [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        title : varchar(255)
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        status : varchar(255)
        agreementId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
    ]

    %% Chain - table `milestones`
    class Milestone [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        milestoneTemplateItemId : bigint <<FK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        attempt : smallint
        status : varchar(32)
        dueAt : date
        lampiranCBy : bigint <<FK>>
    ]

    %% Chain - table `milestone_templates`
    class MilestoneTemplate [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        version : smallint
        isActive : boolean
    ]

    %% Chain - table `milestone_template_items`
    class MilestoneTemplateItem [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        milestoneTemplateId : bigint <<FK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        sequence : smallint
        weight : numeric
    ]

    %% Chain - table `milestone_schedules`
    class MilestoneSchedule [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        code : varchar(32)
        opensAt : date
        dueAt : date
    ]

    %% Chain - table `submission_files`
    class SubmissionFile [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        milestoneId : bigint <<FK>>
        uploadedBy : bigint <<FK>>
        originalName : varchar(255)
        revisionNo : smallint
        isCurrent : boolean
        supersededById : bigint <<FK>>
    ]

    %% Chain - table `submission_events`
    class SubmissionEvent [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        milestoneId : bigint <<FK>>
        actorId : bigint <<FK>>
        event : varchar(64)
        fromStatus : varchar(32)
        toStatus : varchar(32)
    ]

    %% Chain - table `milestone_reviews`
    class MilestoneReview [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        milestoneId : bigint <<FK>>
        reviewerId : bigint <<FK>>
        roundNo : smallint
        ackReceived : boolean
        ackReviewed : boolean
        verdict : varchar(32)
        totalScore : numeric
        maxScore : numeric
    ]

    %% ======== UC-04 ========

    %% People - table `sections`
    class Section [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        code : varchar(16)
        name : varchar(128)
        courseCode : varchar(16)
        lecturerId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
    ]

    %% People - table `lecturer_marks`
    class LecturerMark [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        sectionId : bigint <<FK>>
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        affective : numeric
        cognitive : numeric
        psychomotor : numeric
        enteredBy : bigint <<FK>>
    ]

    %% Registration - table `examiner_pairs`
    class ExaminerPair [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        name : varchar(64)
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        examiner1Id : bigint <<FK>>
        examiner2Id : bigint <<FK>>
        isActive : boolean
    ]

    %% Registration - table `examiner_assignments`
    class ExaminerAssignment [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        examinerId : bigint <<FK>>
        examinerPairId : bigint <<FK>>
        panelRole : varchar(32)
        isActive : boolean
    ]

    %% Assessment - table `rubric_templates`
    class RubricTemplate [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        formCode : varchar(8)
        psmPart : varchar(20)
        assessorType : varchar(20)
        version : smallint
        totalMarks : numeric
        isPublished : boolean
    ]

    %% Assessment - table `rubric_components`
    class RubricComponent [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        rubricTemplateId : bigint <<FK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        title : varchar(255)
        weightPercent : numeric
        sequence : smallint
    ]

    %% Assessment - table `rubric_criteria`
    class RubricCriterion [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        rubricComponentId : bigint <<FK>>
        code : varchar(32)
        title : varchar(255)
        weightPercent : numeric
        maxMarks : numeric
    ]

    %% Assessment - table `assessment_windows`
    class AssessmentWindow [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        formCode : varchar(16)
        psmPart : varchar(16)
        status : varchar(16)
        academicSemesterId : bigint <<FK>>
        openedAt : timestamp
        closedAt : timestamp
    ]

    %% Assessment - table `evaluations`
    class Evaluation [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        assessorId : bigint <<FK>>
        rubricTemplateId : bigint <<FK>>
        assessorType : varchar
        psmPart : varchar
        status : varchar
        rawScore : numeric
        maxScore : numeric
        scorePercent : numeric
        finalScore : numeric
        isLateAssessment : boolean
        submittedAt : timestamp
        releasedAt : timestamp
    ]

    %% Assessment - table `evaluation_scores`
    class EvaluationScore [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        evaluationId : bigint <<FK>>
        rubricComponentId : bigint <<FK>>
        rubricCriterionId : bigint <<FK>>
        itemScore : smallint
        marks : numeric
    ]

    %% ======== UC-05 ========

    %% People - table `coordinator_scopes`
    class CoordinatorScope [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        programme : varchar(8)
    ]

    %% Results - table `final_grades`
    class FinalGrade [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        finalMark : numeric
        releasedAt : timestamp
        releasedBy : bigint <<FK>>
    ]

    %% Results - table `mark_submissions`
    class MarkSubmission [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        studentProfileId : bigint <<FK>>
        finalGradeId : bigint <<FK>>
        status : varchar(255)
        expectedPanelSize : smallint
    ]

    %% Results - table `grade_schemes`
    class GradeScheme [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        passMark : numeric
    ]

    %% Results - table `leaderboards`
    class Leaderboard [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        psmPart : varchar(8)
        status : varchar(32)
        publishedAt : timestamp
    ]

    %% Results - table `leaderboard_entries`
    class LeaderboardEntry [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        leaderboardId : bigint <<FK>>
        projectId : bigint <<FK>>
        finalGradeId : bigint <<FK>>
        rank : smallint
        score : numeric
    ]

    %% ======== UC-06 ========

    %% Term - table `academic_semesters`
    class AcademicSemester [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        name : varchar(255)
        isActive : boolean
        startsAt : date
        endsAt : date
    ]

    %% Term - table `notifications`
    class DatabaseNotification [
        id : uuid <<PK>>
        type : varchar(255)
        notifiableType : varchar(255)
        notifiableId : bigint
        data : text
        readAt : timestamp
    ]

    %% Term - table `reminder_dispatches`
    class ReminderDispatch [
        id : bigint <<PK>>
        milestoneId : bigint <<FK>>
        userId : bigint <<FK>>
        wave : varchar(32)
        sentAt : timestamp
    ]

    %% ---- Associations ----
    %% One line per foreign key the use cases turn on. `*--` is a
    %% composition: the part cannot outlive the whole.

    StudentProfile --|> User : is a
    SupervisorProfile --|> User : is a
    StudentProfile ||--o{ StudentEnrolment : holds
    StudentProfile ||--o| Section : sits in
    User ||--o{ Section : lectures
    User ||--o{ LecturerMark : keys
    Section ||--o{ LecturerMark : records
    StudentProfile ||--o{ LecturerMark : earns
    User ||--o{ CoordinatorScope : scoped as
    User ||--o{ AuditLog : acts
    StudentProfile ||--o{ SupervisorAgreement : files
    SupervisorProfile |o--o{ SupervisorAgreement : signs
    SupervisorAgreement ||--o| Project : becomes
    StudentProfile ||--o{ SupervisionAssignment : paired by
    SupervisorProfile ||--o{ SupervisionAssignment : supervises
    SupervisorAgreement |o--o| SupervisionAssignment : confirmed by
    StudentEnrolment ||--o| Project : starts
    StudentEnrolment |o--o{ StudentEnrolment : repeats
    Project ||--o{ ProjectMember : has
    StudentProfile ||--o{ ProjectMember : takes part as
    Project ||--o{ Milestone : carries
    Project ||--o{ LampiranBForm : files
    Milestone |o--o{ LampiranBForm : carried by
    SupervisorProfile |o--o{ LampiranBForm : files for
    LampiranBForm |o--o| LampiranBForm : superseded by
    MilestoneTemplateItem ||--o{ Milestone : instanced as
    MilestoneTemplate *-- MilestoneTemplateItem : orders
    Milestone *-- SubmissionFile : holds
    Milestone *-- SubmissionEvent : logs
    Milestone *-- MilestoneReview : reviewed by
    Milestone *-- ReminderDispatch : reminds
    User ||--o{ SubmissionFile : uploads
    User ||--o{ SubmissionEvent : triggers
    User |o--o{ MilestoneReview : reviews
    User ||--o{ ReminderDispatch : receives
    AcademicSemester ||--o{ MilestoneSchedule : schedules
    RubricTemplate *-- RubricComponent : contains
    RubricComponent *-- RubricCriterion : breaks into
    Project ||--o{ Evaluation : assessed by
    User ||--o{ Evaluation : assesses
    RubricTemplate ||--o{ Evaluation : governs
    Evaluation *-- EvaluationScore : scores
    RubricComponent |o--o{ EvaluationScore : measured by
    RubricCriterion |o--o{ EvaluationScore : measured by
    AcademicSemester ||--o{ AssessmentWindow : runs
    Project ||--o{ ExaminerAssignment : panel of
    User ||--o{ ExaminerAssignment : examines
    StudentProfile |o--o{ ExaminerAssignment : seated for
    ExaminerPair |o--o{ ExaminerAssignment : seats
    AcademicSemester |o--o{ ExaminerPair : pairs in
    User 1 -- 2 ExaminerPair : examiner 1 / examiner 2
    Project ||--o| FinalGrade : results in
    StudentProfile ||--o{ FinalGrade : awarded
    User |o--o{ FinalGrade : releases
    Project ||--o{ MarkSubmission : closed by
    StudentProfile ||--o{ MarkSubmission : submits
    FinalGrade |o--o{ MarkSubmission : published by
    Project ||--o{ GradeScheme : graded under
    Leaderboard *-- LeaderboardEntry : ranks
    FinalGrade |o--o{ LeaderboardEntry : scores
    Project |o--o{ LeaderboardEntry : listed as
    AcademicSemester ||--o{ StudentEnrolment : enrols
    AcademicSemester ||--o{ Section : provisions
    AcademicSemester |o--o{ Project : placed in
    AcademicSemester |o--o{ StudentProfile : cohort of
    AcademicSemester |o--o{ SupervisorAgreement : filed in
    AcademicSemester |o--o{ LecturerMark : keyed in
    AcademicSemester |o--o{ MarkSubmission : closed in
